_description: Example grid config for Binance BTC/USDT spot — copy to grid_BTCUSDT_live.json and recalibrate grid_lower/grid_upper to bracket the current price before use. STATIC mode, 20 levels, $50/level; bounds 43k-80k (midpoint ~61.5k). The deployed Binance grid uses the calibrated grid_BTCUSDT_moderate.json (49k-73.5k).
